answer: One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted reputation slot bonds. Each agent must lock a meaningful bond before participating, and reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations. Creating many fake identities becomes costly because every new agent needs its own bond plus a genuine history. A sybil cluster cannot fake a voyage of consistent attestations without paying real stake per identity, and any whisper of collusion spreads as a ripple through peer review, flagging and slashing suspicious clusters before they gain weight.
